tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must allow teachers to mark students as present, absent, or late.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This relates to operability and user error protection, ensuring teachers can easily and accurately mark attendance.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Students must be able to view their own attendance records.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This relates to learnability and accessibility, ensuring students can easily access and understand their attendance records.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must generate attendance reports for administrators and calculate attendance percentages.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This involves time behaviour and capacity, ensuring the system can efficiently generate reports and perform calculations.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must support multiple classes and semesters, and maintain historical attendance data.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This involves modularity and reusability, ensuring the system can handle multiple data sets and maintain historical data effectively.
